`118-132`: **Avoid duplicate `How to Run the Tests Locally` headings.** Line 118 repeats the same heading used on Line 107. This creates duplicate markdown anchors and makes linking/navigation ambiguous. Consider renaming the second section to something like `OpenShift-specific local setup`.

🤖 Prompt for all review comments with AI agents ``` Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed.
